zh.thesis: DRAM 地址加扰（scrambling）可被逆向工程，从而突破所有基于内存隔离的 CPU 安全机制。
paragraphs: 通过逆向 AMD Family 16h 的 DRAM 控制器，研究者能重写物理地址转换，使任意地址映射到受保护内存。这包括 PSP、SMM、C6 状态存储和微码，连内核都看不到的区域也被暴露。
工具链 gather_aliases.py 和 unspaghettify.py 可恢复每个 dword 的别名映射，并用于读写受保护区。演示中成功提取了 PSP 的 RSA 引擎和 SMM 入口代码，甚至可修改它们。
现代 CPU 都有类似的 DRAM 加扰机制，AMD、Intel、ARM 等均受影响。这动摇了 SEV、SGX 等所有依赖内存隔离的安全功能，揭示其底层防护的脆弱性。

en.thesis: DRAM address scrambling can be reverse-engineered, breaking all CPU security mechanisms that rely on memory isolation.
paragraphs: By reverse-engineering the DRAM controller of AMD Family 16h, researchers were able to rewrite the physical address translation, mapping arbitrary addresses to protected memory. This includes regions such as PSP, SMM, C6 state storage, and microcode, exposing areas that even the kernel cannot see.

A toolchain consisting of gather_aliases.py and unspaghettify.py can recover the alias mapping for every dword and use it to read and write protected regions. In demonstrations, the team successfully extracted the RSA engine of the PSP and the entry code of SMM, and even modified them.

Modern CPUs from AMD, Intel, and ARM all feature similar DRAM scrambling mechanisms, and all are affected. This undermines every security function that relies on memory isolation, such as SEV and SGX, revealing the fragility of their underlying defenses.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 「全民医保」口号虽吸引人，但应更贴近现有美国老年医保，而非加拿大模式。
paragraphs: 「全民医保」吸引人，因「医保」是既存且受欢迎的项目，且大众在医疗原则上与进步派一致。但该口号未决定具体政策，现实中无法提供无限免费医疗，需在价值观与可行性间找平衡。
美国左翼的「全民医保」多参照加拿大模式，但更明智的是让方案贴近现有美国老年医保。这样既能利用民众对医保的好感，又能减少改革阻力，但需在细节上做出务实调整。

en.thesis: The slogan 'Medicare for All' is appealing, but the policy should be modeled more closely on the existing U.S. Medicare program for seniors rather than the Canadian system.
paragraphs: The slogan 'Medicare for All' is attractive because 'Medicare' is an existing and popular program, and the public's views on healthcare principles align with those of progressives. However, the slogan does not determine specific policy, and in reality, unlimited free healthcare cannot be provided; a balance must be struck between values and feasibility.

The American left's 'Medicare for All' is often modeled on the Canadian system, but it would be wiser to make the proposal closer to the existing U.S. Medicare program. This way, it can leverage the public's fondness for Medicare and reduce resistance to reform, but pragmatic adjustments must be made in the details.

articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 自由民主的衰落源于左翼自由主义自身未能善用建制权力，而非仅由外部威胁造成。
paragraphs: 阿西莫格鲁在与考恩的对谈中提出，左翼自由主义在过去七八十年间虽具影响力，却因错误运用建制权力而自毁根基，变得易受攻击。他认为当前思想混乱堪比十九世纪初，各种理念争夺人心。
他批判社会契约论与卢梭的公意，主张以有意义的个人自由为起点，辅以社群层面的协商。他强调非支配（nondomination）而非单纯不干预（noninterference），并认为国家需提供保护以防强者压制弱者。
当被问及价值冲突时的标准，他坦承没有外部标准，也不认同功利主义或成本-收益分析。他寄望于渐进、不确定的共识演化，如同科学进步，但承认当前并非如此。

en.thesis: The decline of liberal democracy stems from the left-liberal tradition's own failure to wield institutional power effectively, not merely from external threats.
paragraphs: In a conversation with Tyler Cowen, Acemoglu argues that although left-liberalism has been influential over the past seventy or eighty years, it has undermined its own foundations through a misapplication of institutional power, leaving it vulnerable. He likens the current intellectual confusion to that of the early nineteenth century, when competing ideas vied for dominance.

He criticizes social contract theory and Rousseau's general will, advocating instead a meaningful individual freedom as a starting point, complemented by communal deliberation. He emphasizes nondomination over mere noninterference, asserting that the state must provide protection to prevent the strong from oppressing the weak.

When asked about the standard for resolving value conflicts, he admits there is no external standard, and he rejects utilitarianism and cost-benefit analysis. He places his hopes on a gradual, uncertain evolution of consensus, akin to scientific progress, but acknowledges that this is not currently the case.

articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 夜间咖啡因替代品中，paraxanthine 是相对最安全有效的选择。
paragraphs: 咖啡因在体内经 CYP1A2 酶转化，半衰期长达 10 小时，导致晚间饮用影响睡眠。作者探索三种思路：加速代谢的 rutaecarpine、直接服用代谢物 paraxanthine，以及短效类似物 methylliberine。
rutaecarpine 虽能缩短咖啡因作用时间，但可能引发肝损伤，亚马逊评论中有两例肝酶升高；methylliberine 效果因人而异且会抑制 CYP1A2，影响其他药物代谢。相比之下，paraxanthine 作为咖啡因的天然代谢物安全性高，用户评价约 66% 正面，且半衰期仅约 3 小时，是目前最佳选择。

en.thesis: Among nighttime caffeine alternatives, paraxanthine stands out as the safest and most effective option.
paragraphs: Caffeine is converted in the body by the enzyme CYP1A2 and has a half-life of up to 10 hours, which is why consuming it in the evening can disrupt sleep. The author explores three approaches: rutaecarpine to speed up metabolism, taking the metabolite paraxanthine directly, and using a short-acting analog called methylliberine.

While rutaecarpine can shorten the duration of caffeine's effects, it may cause liver damage, with two cases of elevated liver enzymes reported in Amazon reviews. Methylliberine's effects vary from person to person and it inhibits CYP1A2, potentially interfering with the metabolism of other drugs. In contrast, paraxanthine, being a natural metabolite of caffeine, has a strong safety profile, with about 66% positive user reviews, and its half-life is only about 3 hours, making it the best choice currently available.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: Google 官方推荐的七个 NotebookLM 提示词，展示了该工具从问答转向代理式执行的重要转变。
paragraphs: 作者长期使用 NotebookLM，试了 Google 官方推荐的七个提示词后发现，新版本已从仅基于来源回答，变为能直接产出成品。比如学生可一句指令生成五道难度递进的测验，或将零散笔记变成带练习的 PDF 学习指南，省去中间多个步骤。
商业提示词更能体现质变：让 NotebookLM 计算各产品线营收增长并绘图，或读营销简报后上网查竞品再给建议——它现在能在云端跑代码，并融合外部搜索与内部资料。个人场景如整理装修收据成表格，或分析房产购买并建模，也显示来源不再只是终点，而是加工原料。
作者虽对新版仍有保留，但承认官方提示词使其目标更清晰——工具正从研究辅助走向主动代理。文章核心是产品功能解读，而非分析或争议，故分数受限。

en.thesis: Google's official seven NotebookLM prompts reveal the tool's shift from Q&A to agentic execution.
paragraphs: After using NotebookLM for a while, the author tried the seven prompts officially recommended by Google and found that the new version has moved beyond just answering based on sources; it now produces finished outputs directly. For instance, a student can generate a quiz with five difficulty levels in one command, or turn scattered notes into a PDF study guide with exercises, saving many intermediate steps.

The commercial prompts better illustrate this qualitative change: NotebookLM can calculate revenue growth by product line and chart it, or read a marketing brief, search the web for competitors, and then give recommendations—it now runs code in the cloud and blends external search with internal materials. Personal scenarios, like organizing renovation receipts into a table or analyzing a property purchase with modeling, also show that sources are no longer just the end point but raw material to be processed.

The author still has reservations about the new version but admits that the official prompts clarify its direction—the tool is moving from a research aid to a proactive agent. The core of the article is a product feature interpretation, not analysis or controversy, so its score is limited.

zh.thesis: 《独自打保龄》的核心论点——电视挤占了社交活动——在流媒体时代得到验证，但该书的解决方案回避了这一核心问题。
paragraphs: 作者承认年轻时假装读过此书，但重读后惊讶于保龄球隐喻所占篇幅之少，以及他对教会衰退和互联网无法替代线下社交的预言已成真。
年轻的黑泽尔质疑因果链不清晰，将其视为对个人主义的反动。但作者强调，书中明确指出电视是社交资本下降约一半的原因，却未花足够篇幅应对，仍与今日流媒体时代相关。

en.thesis: The core argument of 'Bowling Alone'—that television crowded out social activities—holds up in the streaming era, but the book's solutions sidestep this central problem.
paragraphs: The author admits to having pretended to read the book in his youth, but on rereading was struck by how little space the bowling metaphor actually occupies, and by how prescient his predictions have proved: the decline of churches and the inability of the internet to replace in-person socializing have both come to pass.

The younger Huzel questioned the clarity of the causal chain, seeing the book as a reaction against individualism. But the author emphasizes that the book explicitly identifies television as responsible for about half of the decline in social capital, yet fails to devote enough space to addressing it, making it still relevant to today's streaming age.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 预约链接看似高效，实则将注意力商品化，删除它才能重获对时间的掌控。
paragraphs: 作者曾是预约链接的拥趸，认为Calendly等工具减少了沟通摩擦。但后来发现，这让自己变成自助服务，他人可随意占用其稀缺的专注力。
大多数会议本就无意义，充斥着寒暄和协调，且低效者更爱开会。预约链接将时间变成无限加购的商品，抹杀了判断和协商的价值。
他决定删除链接，重拾日程安排的摩擦，只进行有明确目的和结果的会议。日历应是个人承诺的记录，而非任人挑选的市场。

en.thesis: Calendly links may look efficient, but they turn attention into a commodity; deleting them restores control over your time.
paragraphs: The author was once a big advocate of scheduling links, believing that tools like Calendly cut down on friction in arranging meetings. Over time, though, they realized this turned them into a self-service operation, where anyone could help themselves to their scarce focus.

Most meetings are pointless to begin with, filled with pleasantries and logistics, and the people who love them tend to be the least productive. A scheduling link turns time into an infinite add-to-cart item, erasing the value of judgment and negotiation.

So the author deleted their link, bringing back the friction of arranging meetings by hand, and now only meets when there is a clear purpose and outcome. A calendar should be a record of personal commitments, not a marketplace where anyone can pick you off the shelf.

zh.thesis: 模仿长尾猴叫声驱赶猕猴，成了新德里一项奇特而有效的工作。
paragraphs: 在新德里，猕猴泛滥成灾，偷食滋扰，传统驱赶法效果有限。但长尾猴的叫声能有效震慑它们，于是有人以此为业，专门模仿其叫声。
世界羽毛球锦标赛将在此举办，安保升级，这些'人形驱猴器'变得抢手。这既是古老智慧的延续，也折射出人猴共存的现代难题。

en.thesis: Imitating the calls of langur monkeys to scare away rhesus macaques has become a quirky yet effective job in New Delhi.
paragraphs: In New Delhi, rhesus macaques have become a rampant nuisance, stealing food and causing disturbance, while traditional methods of deterrence have proven limited. However, the calls of langur monkeys are highly effective at intimidating them, leading some people to make a living by mimicking these sounds.

With the World Badminton Championships set to be held here, security has been heightened, making these 'human macaque repellers' highly sought after. This is both a continuation of ancient wisdom and a reflection of the modern dilemma of human-monkey coexistence.

zh.thesis: Gemini 3.7 Flash 以半价提升编码与代理性能，巩固谷歌在高效能模型上的竞争力。
paragraphs: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，距上代仅三周，主打编码与代理工作流。定价为输入每百万 token 0.75 美元，输出 3.75 美元，是 3.6 Flash 首发价的一半，意图以性价比吸引开发者。
基准测试显示显著进步：FrontierCode 1.1 从 34.4% 升至 43.6%，DeepSWE 从 49.0% 升至 65.3%，WebDev Arena Elo 从 1538 升至 1588。复杂文档处理（GDP.pdf）从 22% 跃至 34%，自动化业务流程（AutomationBench）从 17% 升至 30.4%。
该模型已集成至个人代理 Gemini Spark，并强调安全性更新。但发布本身属产品迭代，缺少独立分析，仅报告事实，故评分偏低。

en.thesis: Gemini 3.7 Flash, priced at half the rate of its predecessor, boosts coding and agentic performance, strengthening Google's competitive position in efficient models.
paragraphs: Google has released Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after the previous version, focusing on coding and agentic workflows. Pricing is set at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, half the launch price of 3.6 Flash, aiming to attract developers with cost-effectiveness.

Benchmarks show significant gains: FrontierCode 1.1 rose from 34.4% to 43.6%, DeepSWE from 49.0% to 65.3%, and WebDev Arena Elo from 1538 to 1588. Complex document processing (GDP.pdf) jumped from 22% to 34%, and automated business processes (AutomationBench) increased from 17% to 30.4%.

The model is integrated into the personal agent Gemini Spark, with security enhancements emphasized. However, the release is a product iteration without independent analysis, reporting only facts, so it scores low.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约的住房建设热潮受制于地方政治与法律障碍，而不仅仅是土地供给。
paragraphs: 市长赞格兰·马姆达尼向高价值二套房征收的「皮埃德-à-terre」税被史泰登岛法官叫停，凸显地方司法对住房政策的制约。文章以纽约为例，探讨建设热潮为何难以转化为切实的住房供应。
具体而言，政治阻力与法律挑战往往使新政策难以落地，而旧有的区划法规又限制了开发密度。旧金山等城市的教训表明，仅靠增加建筑许可不足以解决可负担性问题，必须改革制度性障碍。

en.thesis: New York's housing construction boom is hindered by local politics and legal barriers, not just land supply.
paragraphs: Mayor Zanglan Mamdani's 'pied-à-terre' tax on high-value second homes was struck down by a Staten Island judge, highlighting the constraints that local judiciary can place on housing policy. The article uses New York as a case study to explore why a construction boom does not necessarily translate into tangible housing supply.

Specifically, political resistance and legal challenges often hinder the implementation of new policies, while outdated zoning regulations restrict development density. Lessons from cities like San Francisco show that merely increasing building permits is insufficient to solve affordability; institutional barriers must be reformed.

zh.thesis: GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式以 750 tokens/秒 的速度提供同等质量，将改写时间敏感型 AI 应用。
paragraphs: Cerebras 与 OpenAI 合作推出 Ultrafast 模式，用晶圆级引擎将 44GB SRAM 置于芯片上，避免 GPU 的内存带宽瓶颈。该模式先向部分客户开放，声称速度比 Fable 5 快 11 倍。
在 HLE 测试中，Sol 以 11 小时答完 2500 道博士级问题，比 Claude 快 7 倍；在 GDP-Val 上提速 5.6 倍且质量无损。这引发推理速度竞争，可能使 AI 更快融入实时决策。

en.thesis: GPT-5.6 Sol's Ultrafast mode delivers equal quality at 750 tokens per second, reshaping time-sensitive AI applications.
paragraphs: Cerebras and OpenAI have teamed up to introduce Ultrafast mode, which uses a wafer-scale engine to place 44GB of SRAM directly on the chip, bypassing the memory bandwidth bottleneck typical of GPUs. The mode is initially being rolled out to select customers, with claims of being 11 times faster than Fable 5.

In the HLE benchmark, Sol completed 2,500 doctoral-level questions in 11 hours, seven times faster than Claude, and achieved a 5.6-times speedup on GDP-Val with no loss in quality. This sparks a race in inference speed, potentially accelerating AI's integration into real-time decision-making.

zh.thesis: 链接聚合的价值在于提示值得深挖的话题，而非本身提供分析。
paragraphs: 此为精选链接列表，涵盖AI写论文、医学未来、社会科学可推广性等议题。每则链接仅一短语，缺乏展开论证。
例如首条链接建议用AI六天写论文并记录过程，但未述细节或效果。此类内容适合浏览发现，不适合深度阅读。

en.thesis: The value of link roundups lies in highlighting topics worth exploring, not in providing analysis themselves.
paragraphs: This is a curated list of links covering topics from AI-assisted thesis writing to the future of medicine and the generalizability of social science research. Each link is accompanied by only a brief phrase, lacking any developed argument.

For instance, the first link suggests using AI to write a thesis in six days while documenting the process, but it offers no details or outcomes. Such content is suitable for browsing and discovery, not for in-depth reading.

zh.thesis: DeepSeek Harness 将代理的一切能力做成可替换插件，并记录完整轨迹，但本文只是发布公告。
paragraphs: DeepSeek 发布 Harness 开发者预览版，宣称一切皆插件：模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度、UI 均可配置替换。其核心是 Cordis 内核负责插件的挂载与依赖管理。
设计强调可追溯性：模型所见全部记录在只增日志中，包括系统提示、推理、工具调用及结果，支持恢复、分叉、搜索与回放。运行模式分标准、代码、最小与创建者四种，灵活适配不同场景。
这属于产品发布公告，缺乏深度分析或对比，信息以功能列举为主。对开发者有参考价值，但一般读者获得的洞见有限。

en.thesis: DeepSeek Harness turns every capability of an agent into a replaceable plugin and logs the full trajectory, but this piece is just a release announcement.
paragraphs: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of its Harness, claiming that everything is a plugin: models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and UI can all be configured and swapped. At its core is the Cordis kernel, which handles plugin mounting and dependency management.

The design emphasizes traceability: everything the model sees is recorded in an append-only log, including system prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and their results, with support for resuming, forking, searching, and replaying. There are four runtime modes—standard, code, minimal, and creator—to flexibly suit different use cases.

This is a product release announcement, lacking deep analysis or comparison, and the information consists mainly of feature lists. It offers reference value for developers, but general readers will glean limited insight.

zh.thesis: 在科技界，坚持己见而非随大流，才是真正的护城河。
paragraphs: 文章批评科技界普遍遵循同一套成功模板，认为这导致同质化竞争。作者提出，真正的优势来自与众不同的信念和行动。
他以星巴克为例，说明其从咖啡公司转型为第三空间，靠的是对顾客体验的独特坚持，而非跟随行业标准。这种反叛精神被作者称为「异端指南」。
文章是付费播客的简介，内容简略，缺乏具体论证和数据支持，更像一个宣言而非深入分析。其核心观点虽有趣，但缺乏展开。

en.thesis: In the tech world, true moat lies in sticking to your own convictions rather than following the crowd.
paragraphs: The article criticizes the tech industry for universally following the same success template, which leads to homogeneous competition. The author argues that real advantage comes from unconventional beliefs and actions.

Using Starbucks as an example, he illustrates how the company transformed from a coffee business into a 'third place' by stubbornly focusing on customer experience, not by following industry standards. This rebellious spirit is what the author calls a 'heretic's guide'.

The piece serves as a blurb for a paid podcast, so it is brief and lacks detailed argumentation or data; it reads more like a manifesto than deep analysis. Its core idea is interesting but remains underdeveloped.

zh.thesis: 《Gloomberb》这个标题本身没有提供任何可争议的论点，只是一条新闻标题。
paragraphs: 这篇文章仅提供了标题“Gloomberb”，没有正文内容可分析。因此无法提炼出具体的观点、证据或论证过程。
作为一篇无法获取内容的文章，它只能被归类为纯粹的新闻公告，缺乏深度分析。评分因此较低，仅为30分，因为它没有传达任何实质性的见解。

en.thesis: The headline 'Gloomberb' offers no arguable thesis; it is merely a news headline.
paragraphs: This article provides only the headline 'Gloomberb' with no body content to analyze. Therefore, no specific viewpoint, evidence, or argumentation can be extracted.

As an article whose content cannot be accessed, it can only be classified as a pure news announcement, lacking in-depth analysis. Its score is consequently low, only 30 points, because it conveys no substantive insight.

zh.thesis: 美国某些事实值得关注。
paragraphs: 本文仅是一条简短的事实播报，几乎没有展开论述。
内容缺乏具体数据和深入分析，难以提炼出有价值的主张。

en.thesis: Certain facts about the United States merit attention.
paragraphs: This entry is simply a brief factual bulletin, with virtually no elaboration.
The content lacks specific data and in-depth analysis, making it difficult to distill any valuable claim.

articles.title: Codex in ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is now in preview
articles.author: allanrbo

zh.thesis: ChatGPT 桌面应用与 Codex 现已登陆 Linux 预览版，但此事本身并无新论点。
paragraphs: OpenAI 在 X 上宣布，ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex）已推出 Linux 预览版，支持已有项目和浏览器工作流。
这只是一条产品发布消息，无分析或争议论点，对普通读者价值有限，且对 Linux 用户而言是便利，但并非重大事件。

en.thesis: The ChatGPT desktop app and Codex are now available in a Linux preview, but this announcement carries no new argument.
paragraphs: OpenAI announced on X that the ChatGPT desktop app, including ChatGPT Work and Codex, has launched in a Linux preview, supporting existing projects and browser workflows.

This is merely a product release announcement, with no analysis or contentious points, offering limited value to the general reader, and while it is convenient for Linux users, it is not a major event.
